# CS IMPACT ANALYSIS: Rewards earning rules display

## CONTACT DRIVERS (maximum 5, highest likelihood only):

1. **Why did I get lower cashback than expected?**
   - Scenario: User sees 2% cashback displayed but earned only 1%, doesn't understand the earning rule conditions or exclusions that applied
   - Likelihood: High
   - PRD gap: No - PRD does not specify how exclusions, caps, or conditional logic will be communicated

2. **Where can I see the full earning rules for my card?**
   - Scenario: User sees partial explanation after transaction but wants comprehensive view of all earning scenarios before spending
   - Likelihood: High
   - PRD gap: Partial - Feature shows "why they earned" post-transaction but unclear if proactive rules display exists

3. **Why did my earning rate change from last month?**
   - Scenario: User earned 5% on travel last month, now sees 2% on similar transaction, no explanation of milestone-based or time-bound rule changes
   - Likelihood: High
   - PRD gap: No - PRD doesn't address how rule changes, milestone unlocks, or spend-based tier changes are communicated

4. **The cashback shown doesn't match what I actually received**
   - Scenario: Display shows one earning rule/rate but settlement amount differs due to merchant category mismatch, processing delays, or reversals
   - Likelihood: Medium
   - PRD gap: No - No mention of handling timing differences between display and actual credit, or dispute resolution flow

5. **What does 'combined monthly spend of ₹20,000' mean for my rewards?**
   - Scenario: User sees earning rule with spend threshold requirement but unclear if it's per card, across cards, includes/excludes certain categories
   - Likelihood: Medium
   - PRD gap: No - PRD doesn't specify how complex conditional rules (thresholds, category combinations, exclusions) are explained

## COMPETITOR CX BENCHMARK:

**Contact Driver 1: Lower cashback than expected**
- Competitor: Scapia handles this with upfront transparency - "Unlocks on a combined monthly spend of ₹20,000" shown before transaction, not just after
- Self-serve: Proactive in-app display with clear unlock conditions
- PIXEL should copy: Show unlock progress and conditions BEFORE transaction, not just explanation after. Add "Why this rate?" tooltip on transaction screen
- Source: https://www.scapia.cards/

**Contact Driver 2: Full earning rules visibility**
- Competitor: Scapia provides dedicated rewards section in "beautiful app" with comprehensive program information accessible anytime
- Self-serve: Full program details in app, not requiring transaction to see rules
- PIXEL should improve: Create persistent "My Rewards Rules" section, not just post-transaction explanations. Add category-wise breakdown and examples
- Source: https://www.instagram.com/reel/DOn-ixyk94e/

**Contact Driver 3: Earning rate changes**
- Best practice: Credit card issuers provide redemption history with rate changes documented (per Corporate Insight research)
- Self-serve: Historical view with change notifications
- PIXEL should copy: Add "Rate History" view showing when/why rates changed, with proactive notifications before changes take effect
- Source: https://corporateinsight.com/credit-card-reward-redemption-interface-features-and-design/

**Contact Driver 4: Display vs actual mismatch**
- Best practice: Leading issuers show pending vs posted rewards separately with expected credit dates
- Agent-assisted: Requires backend reconciliation tools for agents
- PIXEL should copy: Separate "Expected" vs "Credited" rewards with status tracking, clear timeline for when rewards post
- Source: https://corporateinsight.com/credit-card-reward-redemption-interface-features-and-design/

**Contact Driver 5: Complex conditional rules**
- Competitor: Scapia breaks down "combined monthly spend" with clear category inclusions and progress tracking
- Self-serve: Interactive calculator showing spend progress toward unlock thresholds
- PIXEL should improve: Add spend-to-unlock calculator, visual progress bars, and plain-language rule explanations with examples
- Source: https://www.scapia.cards/

## FAQ COVERAGE (maximum 5 only):

**FAQ 1:**
- Question: Why did I only get 1% cashback when the app showed I would earn 2%?
- Answer: The 2% rate requires ₹20,000 monthly spend across all categories. You've spent ₹12,450 this month, so the base 1% rate applies. Spend ₹7,550 more to unlock 2% on future transactions. Check "My Rewards Progress" in the app to track your unlock status.
- Escalation needed: No

**FAQ 2:**
- Question: Where can I see all the cashback rates for different types of purchases?
- Answer: Open PIXEL app → Rewards tab → "My Earning Rules" to see your complete rate card. You'll find rates by category (travel, dining, shopping), spend thresholds to unlock higher rates, and any exclusions. You can also tap "Why this rate?" on any transaction to see the specific rule that applied.
- Escalation needed: No

**FAQ 3:**
- Question: My travel cashback was 5% last month but only 2% this month, what changed?
- Answer: Your travel rate decreased because [check agent system for specific reason: milestone period ended / spend threshold not met / promotional period expired]. I can see in your account that [specific rule change]. To get 5% again, you need to [specific action]. I'll send you a summary of your current rates and how to unlock higher tiers.
- Escalation needed: Yes (requires backend access to rule change history)

**FAQ 4:**
- Question: The app said I earned ₹150 cashback but I only received ₹100, why?
- Answer: I can see the ₹150 was displayed based on initial merchant category, but the transaction settled as [different category] which earns [lower rate]. Cashback is finalized after merchant settlement (3-5 days). I'm checking if this is a category mismatch that needs correction. [If error: I'll raise a dispute ticket and you'll receive the ₹50 difference within 7 working days.]
- Escalation needed: Yes (requires transaction reconciliation and potential dispute)

**FAQ 5:**
- Question: What counts toward my ₹20,000 monthly spend to unlock better rewards?
- Answer: Your ₹20,000 threshold includes all card purchases except [list exclusions: cash withdrawals, EMI conversions, fuel surcharge, wallet loads]. Rent, utilities, shopping, dining, and travel all count. Your current month's eligible spend is ₹[amount]. The counter resets on the 1st of each month. Check real-time progress in app under "Rewards Progress."
- Escalation needed: No

## AGENT CENTRE REQUIREMENTS:

- **Transaction-level earning rule applied** (rule ID, rule name, rate applied, why this rule was selected)
- **User's current reward tier/milestone status** (spend progress, unlock thresholds, tier expiry dates) [NOT IN PRD]
- **Earning rule change history** (when rules changed, old vs new rates, reason for change) [NOT IN PRD]
- **Category classification for each transaction** (merchant category code, PIXEL category mapping, any overrides)
- **Exclusions applied to transaction** (which exclusions triggered, rule logic explanation) [NOT IN PRD]
- **Pending vs posted rewards status** (expected amount, actual credited amount, settlement date, any discrepancies) [NOT IN PRD]
- **Monthly spend progress breakdown** (eligible spend, excluded spend, category-wise split, days remaining in cycle) [NOT IN PRD]
- **Promotional/time-bound rules active** (start/end dates, eligibility criteria, user qualification status) [NOT IN PRD]
- **Dispute history for rewards** (previous mismatches, resolutions, pending investigations) [NOT IN PRD]
- **User's complete rate card** (all earning rules, conditions, caps, current qualification status) [NOT IN PRD]

## ERROR SCREEN AUDIT:

**Error 1: Earning rule cannot be displayed**
- Error scenario: Backend fails to retrieve earning rule logic for completed transaction
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Show "Cashback earned: ₹[amount]. Rule details temporarily unavailable. Check back in 1 hour or contact support for details."

**Error 2: Spend progress data unavailable**
- Error scenario: Monthly spend calculation service down, cannot show progress toward unlock thresholds
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Show last known progress with timestamp: "Progress as of [date/time]. Current data temporarily unavailable. Your rewards are still being earned normally."

**Error 3: Rate mismatch detected**
- Error scenario: System detects displayed rate differs from actually credited rate
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Show alert: "We're reviewing your cashback for this transaction. Expected: ₹X, Credited: ₹Y. We'll update you within 24 hours. No action needed."

**Error 4: Rule change not synced**
- Error scenario: User's tier changed but display still shows old earning rules
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Force refresh with message: "Your rewards program updated. Refreshing your rates..." then show updated rules with "What changed" summary.

**Error 5: Category classification pending**
- Error scenario: Transaction too recent, merchant category not yet finalized, earning rule cannot be determined
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Show "Cashback pending - merchant category confirmation in progress. Estimated: ₹X-₹Y based on possible categories. Final amount in 3-5 days."

**Error 6: Exclusion rule conflict**
- Error scenario: Multiple exclusion rules apply, system cannot determine which takes precedence
- Current PRD handling: Not documented
- Recommended next action: Show "Cashback calculation in review. You'll see final amount within 24 hours" with support contact option.

## ESCALATION PATHS:

**Scenario 1: Earning rule logic dispute**
- User claims rule was misapplied, requires investigation of rule engine decision
- Who handles it: Tier-2 CS with access to rule engine logs and product team consultation
- Expected resolution time: 48-72 hours

**Scenario 2: Merchant category reclassification**
- Transaction categorized incorrectly, user wants different earning rate applied retroactively
- Who handles it: Bank team / Zeta ops (requires merchant database update or manual override)
- Expected resolution time: 5-7 working days

**Scenario 3: Promotional rule not applied**
- User qualified for limited-time offer but system didn't apply enhanced rate
- Who handles it: Tier-2 CS with ability to manually credit difference after verification
- Expected resolution time: 3-5 working days (verification + manual credit)

**Scenario 4: Spend threshold calculation error**
- User believes they crossed unlock threshold but system shows different spend total
- Who handles it: Tier-2 CS with transaction audit access, may need Zeta ops for spend recalculation
- Expected resolution time: 72 hours (requires transaction-by-transaction audit)

**Scenario 5: Bulk rate change complaint**
- User's earning rates changed without notification, wants explanation and potential reversal
- Who handles it: Bank team / product team (policy decision on whether to grandfather old rates)
- Expected resolution time: 7-10 working days (requires policy review)

## TICKET DEFLECTION OPPORTUNITIES:

**Opportunity 1: Interactive earning rule calculator**
- What to build: Pre-transaction calculator where users input amount and category to see exact cashback before spending, with threshold unlock preview
- Estimated ticket reduction: 35%
- Complexity: Medium

**Opportunity 2: Proactive rate change notifications**
- What to build: Push notification + in-app alert 7 days before any earning rule changes, with old vs new comparison and impact on user's typical spending
- Estimated ticket reduction: 25%
- Complexity: Low

**Opportunity 3: Real-time spend progress dashboard**
- What to build: Visual dashboard showing progress toward each unlock threshold, category-wise spend breakdown, projected rewards at current pace, days remaining
- Estimated ticket reduction: 30%
- Complexity: Medium

**Opportunity 4: Transaction-level "Why this rate?" tooltip**
- What to build: Expandable explanation on every transaction showing: rate applied, why this rate, what was excluded, how to earn more, with examples
- Estimated ticket reduction: 40%
- Complexity: Low
